openings.claim: Return-to-home plus visitor language choice before handoff could remove inherited language state and shorten navigation. Menu readiness, requested language and battery readiness become joint handoff conditions.
openings.discriminator: If inherited menu state causes delays, paired steps may outperform reset alone or advance choice alone; effects remain untested.
openings.probe: Compare paired steps, each alone and existing practice across matched language requests. Stop if average return handling exceeds 30 seconds.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes reliable home-screen reset and communicating choice without retained visitor data. Independent submenu contribution, reset effects on charge indication and return/admission overlap remain unknown.

openings.claim: Language-specific dock positions plus visible menu-state checks might reduce wrong-language handoffs by aligning location cues with actual settings. Location and verified setting jointly replace charge indication as the availability cue.
openings.discriminator: If location cues remain accurate, paired steps may outperform dock grouping alone; uneven language demand could erase the benefit.
openings.probe: Compare paired steps with grouping alone under equal and uneven demand. Stop if admission work is delayed or visitor history retained.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes dock positions can be marked without replacement and setting checks consume no admission capacity; feasibility and effects remain untested.

lineage.reason: Causal relation, joint conditions, both rivals, full comparison, stop, assumptions and conditional fit retained.
Causal relation, joint cue, rival, demand challenge/defeat, comparison, both stops, assumptions and uncertain fit retained.

decision: Historical synthetic proposal, never fresh replication. Target: at least 95% of stipulated entrance-period handoffs play the requested language within one minute. Preserve twelve existing handsets/dock, attendant admission responsibility, no added staff, no visitor identities or persistent listening histories, and average returns <=30 seconds. Resources: existing language cards and timing sheet. Charge-only baseline averages eight seconds. Probe D1 and D2 conditionally; unknown feasibility permits no constraint relaxation.
